requirements.desc: Interactive `senti setup` lets the user select claude only, codex only, or claude + codex as available agents, and asks for a main/default agent only when both families are selected.
requirements.note: R1: interactive setup prompt plan asks main agent only for dual-family selections

requirements.desc: Setup writes `agent.default` as `claude` or `codex` and writes `agent.useProfile` as `claude-only`, `codex-only`, `claude-main`, or `codex-main` according to selected availability and main agent.
requirements.note: R2: generated setup agent config stores aliases and useProfile without built-in profiles/providers

requirements.desc: Non-interactive `senti setup --agent` accepts single values `claude` / `codex` and comma-separated multi-agent values; for multi-agent values, the first listed family is the main/default agent.
requirements.note: R3: non-interactive --agent uses first-listed main semantics

requirements.desc: Runtime agent resolution and config validation resolve package built-in profiles/providers without requiring them to be copied into `.senti/config.json`, while user-defined `agent.profiles` and `agent.providers` override built-ins by key.
requirements.note: R4: validation and runtime resolution accept built-in profiles without config-local copies

requirements.desc: Normal setup and upgrade do not add package built-in `agent.profiles` or `agent.providers` entries to config; existing unknown entries remain preserved as user overrides.
requirements.note: R5: setup config generation does not seed built-ins and preserves unknown user entries

requirements.desc: When both claude and codex are selected interactively, setup lets the user choose AGENTS.md and/or CLAUDE.md generation targets; when both are selected non-interactively, setup generates both files by default.
requirements.note: R6: multi-agent setup resolves interactive and non-interactive file targets

requirements.desc: Setup completion output and help/docs explain selected `agent.default`, selected `agent.useProfile`, available built-in profile names, and override examples for `agent.profiles` and `agent.providers`.
requirements.note: R7: setup summary exposes selected aliases, useProfile, and built-in profile names

requirements.desc: Existing concrete provider key defaults such as `claude/sonnet` or `codex/gpt-5.4` remain resolvable until setup or an explicit user edit rewrites them to family aliases.
requirements.note: R8: existing concrete provider key defaults remain resolvable

requirements.desc: Rerunning setup normalizes existing `agent.default` family aliases, concrete provider keys, and built-in `agent.useProfile` names into wizard availability and main/default defaults before prompting or rewriting config.
requirements.note: R9: existing agent config normalizes into setup wizard defaults
